lines.zh: 嘶嘶嘶，游动时发出响声。
lines.en: Sssss, makes a noise while swimming.
Large body sways in the water.

lines.zh: 尾巴一甩，卷起阵阵波浪。
lines.en: Tail swishes, creating waves.

lines.zh: 皮肤光滑，鳞片反射着阳光。
lines.en: Smooth skin with scales reflecting sunlight.
Releases bubbles.
Moves slowly, searching for prey.
Water ripples.
Tail breaks the surface.
Rubs back with scales.

lines.zh: 我摆尾下沉，只剩一圈涟漪。
lines.en: A flick of my tail and only ripples remain.

lines.zh: 我在海草间穿行，尾鳍轻摆。
lines.en: I thread through the seagrass, tail fin swaying.

lines.zh: 贴着海床滑行，沙子扬起。
lines.en: I glide along the seabed, kicking up sand.

lines.zh: 浮到水面换气，再沉下去。
lines.en: I surface for air, then sink again.

lines.zh: 背鳍划开暗流，向前推进。
lines.en: My dorsal fin cuts the current as I push on.
Silently glides on the seabed.
Rises to the surface to breathe.
Stares at a distant shadow.
Occasionally emits a low roar.
Buries itself in the sand.

lines.zh: 我伏在海床上，等水波变乱。
lines.en: I lie on the seabed, waiting for the water to ripple wrong.
Moves occasionally.
Remains still, observing.
Shakes its head occasionally.
Slowly swims, searching for food.
Notices the player, staring at him.

lines.zh: 我的瞳孔缩成一条，锁在你身上。
lines.en: My pupils narrow to slits, fixed on you.

lines.zh: 我露出水面，只让眼睛对着你。
lines.en: I surface just enough to aim one eye at you.
Shows a fierce gaze.
Out of water, I can't move at all.
Stares at the player, ready to attack.
Scans for the player's weaknesses.
Suddenly lunges at the player.
Approaches the player, ready to hunt.

lines.zh: 这片海归我，岸上我动不了。
lines.en: This sea is mine; on land I can barely move.

lines.zh: 水流不住地吞噬着我庞大的身躯。
lines.en: The water won't stop devouring my massive body.
The sea eats at my scales.

lines.zh: 海水的腐蚀让我的皮肤腐烂。
lines.en: The water's corrosion eats away at my flesh.

lines.zh: 鳞缝里渗出血，我翻了个身。
lines.en: Blood seeps between my scales and I roll over.

lines.zh: 沉重的伤害让我喘不过气。
lines.en: The heavy damage leaves me gasping.

lines.zh: 伤口从我体内流出海水。
lines.en: Seawater flows from my wounds.
Pain leaves me unable to breathe.
Seawater flows into my wounds.
The pain leaves me unable to move.
I struggle to surface.

lines.zh: 水面上漂浮，静静等待猎物上门。
lines.en: Sits on the surface, waiting for prey to come.

lines.zh: 巨大的脑袋露出水面，张开巨颚。
lines.en: Large head breaks the surface, wide open jaws.

lines.zh: 你游得再快也逃不出我的掌控。
lines.en: You can’t escape my grasp no matter how fast you swim.

lines.zh: 用你自己的血肉填饱我的胃吧。
lines.en: Fill my stomach with your flesh.
One step from water and I bite.

lines.zh: 在水中畅游，寻找新鲜猎物。
lines.en: Swimming in the water, searching for fresh prey.

lines.zh: 我的体型远超任何鱼类。
lines.en: My size far exceeds any fish.
Your meat is too small for me.

lines.zh: 水面下我的力量无处不在。
lines.en: My power is everywhere under the water.
Swallow the prey and enjoy the taste.

lines.zh: 巨大的身躯冲撞而来，震动整个水面。
lines.en: Massive body collides, shaking the entire surface.

lines.zh: 身体碰撞，激起巨大的水花。
lines.en: Body collision, creating massive waves.
Touch means death.

lines.zh: 用你的身体测试我的力量。
lines.en: Test my strength with your body.
Collide, crush everything in your way.

lines.zh: 坚硬的鳞片击打，无坚不摧。
lines.en: Hard scales strike, nothing can resist.

lines.zh: 力量的碰撞，展示谁更强大。
lines.en: Collision of power, showing who’s stronger.

lines.zh: 我的身体就是我的武器。
lines.en: My body is my weapon.
Collide, shred you to pieces.

lines.zh: 用身体力量对抗我，你会后悔。
lines.en: Meet the power of my body, you’ll regret it.

lines.zh: 海里找个同伴，靠声音就行。
lines.en: In the sea, a call is enough to find a mate.

lines.zh: 与同类交配，确保物种延续。
lines.en: Mate with同类, ensuring species survival.

lines.zh: 交配时释放强烈气味吸引对方。
lines.en: Release strong scent to attract a partner.

lines.zh: 寻找伴侣，共同守护后代。
lines.en: Seek a partner, protect offspring together.

lines.zh: 交配时展现自己的强大。
lines.en: Mate, showing my power.
Mate, securing the future of the species.
Find a mate, build a nest together.
Mate, the continuation of life.
Seek a partner, to reproduce together.

lines.zh: 我们并排游，尾鳍频率一样。
lines.en: We swim side by side, tail fins in rhythm.
Ssssh, sink down!
Tail like tentacles, coming!
Feeling you, getting closer!
Strong suction, pulling you!
Open wide, ready to devour!
You can't escape, swallowed!
Massive body, crushing all!
Hard skin, can't hurt!
Release poison, slowly kill!
Deep sea's ruler, few fear!
Target locked, locked sight!
Tracking prey, where are you!
Sensing prey, locked on!
Sonar locked, target clear!
Locating prey, ready to attack!
Target locked, scent locked!
Target clear, locked on!
Sonar locked, target locked!

lines.zh: 水波带回你的重量，错不了。
lines.en: The ripples carry your weight; no mistake.
Sonar scan, target locked!
That vibration in the water is unmistakable.
You weigh just less than I do.
This one ends in the water.

lines.zh: 我的巨颚已经张到最大。
lines.en: My jaws are already open as wide as they go.

lines.zh: 你踩进浅水，就是送上门。
lines.en: Stepping into the shallows is delivering yourself.
The ripples point at you; I am certain.

lines.zh: 水压先压住你，牙随后到。
lines.en: Water pressure pins you first, then my teeth arrive.
In water, prey ends in one bite.
At this depth you cannot turn over.
Target locked, choke hold!
Target locked, tearing bite!
Target locked, lethal ram!
Target locked, deadly claw!
Target locked, death lock!
I dive, then rise from below.
The pressure hits first, then the teeth.
The water behind you suddenly turns cold.
I circle you, drawing a ring.
Do not go ashore; I will wait at the shore.
My tail is loaded and ready to strike.

lines.zh: 你的影子在水面被我看见。
lines.en: I see your shadow on the surface.
One meter deeper, and you cannot escape.

lines.zh: 我张嘴时，水会先涌进来。
lines.en: When I open my jaws, the water rushes in first.
This depth is mine to rule.
I never chase; I wait.
My teeth are rising row by row.

lines.zh: 发出震耳欲聋的吼声，它粗壮的尾巴拍击水面！
lines.en: Roars loudly, slapping the water with its thick tail!

lines.zh: 长满利齿的巨颚撕裂对手的皮肉！
lines.en: Its giant jaw rips through flesh and skin!

lines.zh: 巨大的身躯在水中翻腾，溅起层层浪花！
lines.en: Its massive body roars through the water, creating waves!

lines.zh: 长长的脖子弯成弓形，准备下一次攻击！
lines.en: Its long neck arches, ready for another attack!

lines.zh: 尾巴猛地一甩，激起巨大的水花！
lines.en: Its tail swishes, creating a massive splash!

lines.zh: 粗大的四肢在水中挥舞，寻找猎物！
lines.en: Its thick limbs swing in the water, searching for prey!

lines.zh: 巨大的爪子夹住目标，撕咬不放！
lines.en: Its giant claws grip and tear at the target!

lines.zh: 它张开巨大颚，露出锋利的牙齿！
lines.en: It opens its huge jaws, revealing sharp teeth!

lines.zh: 粗壮的四肢在水中划出有力的波纹！
lines.en: Its thick limbs carve out powerful waves in the water!

lines.zh: 巨大的鳞片在阳光下闪烁，威风凛凛！
lines.en: Its massive scales shimmer in the sunlight, intimidating!
My jaws snap shut, and the water bursts!
I ram you and crack every rib!

lines.zh: 咬住拖下水，别想浮上来！
lines.en: I bite and drag you down; you will not surface!

lines.zh: 尾巴横扫，把你拍进海床！
lines.en: My tail sweeps you into the seabed!
Row after row of teeth bite in turn!

lines.zh: 水花还没落，第二口来了！
lines.en: The spray has not fallen before the second bite!

lines.zh: 我翻滚起来，把你绞进涡里！
lines.en: I roll, twisting you into the whirl!
One bite, scale and bone together!
In the shallows you cannot even stand!

lines.zh: 我一路把你顶到礁石上！
lines.en: I drive you all the way onto the reef!

lines.zh: 在深邃的海洋中孵化而出！
lines.en: Hatches from the deep ocean!

lines.zh: 潜入漆黑的深海，悄然出世！
lines.en: Emerges silently from the dark depths!

lines.zh: 破壳而出，幼龙在水中成长！
lines.en: Hatches, the young mosasaurus grows in the water!

lines.zh: 幼龙在深海中寻找食物，渐渐长大！
lines.en: The young mosasaurus hunts in the deep sea, growing bigger!

lines.zh: 成年沧龙在海底的暗礁间游弋！
lines.en: The adult mosasaurus swims among the underwater reefs!

lines.zh: 幼体在珊瑚丛中躲避敌人！
lines.en: The young one hides in the coral reefs!

lines.zh: 它在海床上挖掘，寻找美味的食物！
lines.en: It digs in the seafloor, searching for delicious food!

lines.zh: 成年沧龙在沙洲上休憩，恢复体力！
lines.en: The adult mosasaurus rests on the sandbars, recovering its strength!

lines.zh: 幼龙在海草中游动，吸取养分！
lines.en: The young one swims in the sea grass, absorbing nutrients!

lines.zh: 成年沧龙潜入深海，捕食更大猎物！
lines.en: The adult mosasaurus dives into the deep sea to hunt larger prey!

lines.zh: 海沟深处，一个巨大的影子动了。
lines.en: Deep in the trench, a huge shadow moves.

lines.zh: 卵在暖流里裂开，我游出来。
lines.en: My egg splits in the warm current, and I swim out.

lines.zh: 海面翻了一下，我浮上来。
lines.en: The surface heaves once, and I rise.

lines.zh: 沉船旁，我的背鳍露出水。
lines.en: By the wreck, my dorsal fin breaks the surface.
Fire licks my skin.
I fall from high into the sea.
I'm stranded on the surface.

lines.zh: 爆浪掀开鳞片，海水灌进来。
lines.en: The blast tears my scales open and seawater floods in.
The projectile hits my scales.

lines.zh: 魔法的光芒贯穿了我的身躯。
lines.en: Magic sears through my body.
Hunger weakens me.

lines.zh: 水里我能秒杀，离水就动不了。
lines.en: I kill in water but cannot move out of it.
The void devours my body.
